testo:
■ If you have the Light, Water and Darkness civilizations in your mana zone, you may pay Costicon to summon this creature.
■ Neo Evolution: You may put this creature on top of one of your light, water or darkness creatures.
■ When you put this creature, shieldify the top card of your deck.

■ 自分のマナゾーンに光、水、闇の各文明があれば、このクリーチャーをCosticon支払ってしょうかん召喚してもよい。
